# `<dev/hid.h>`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

USB HID keyboard usage IDs (usage page 7), the key identifiers used above the hardware.

Keyboard drivers translate their own scancodes to these, and keymap.h turns them into bytes.

```c
#include <dev/hid.h>
```
